blob.description: A description of the blob that was written and read.

overwrite_elapsed.description:
The elapsed time spent overwriting the blob.
If the blob was not overwritten, this information is omitted.

overwrite_elapsed_nanos.description:
The elapsed time spent overwriting the blob, in nanoseconds.
If the blob was not overwritten, this information is omitted.

write_elapsed.description: The elapsed time spent writing the blob.

write_elapsed_nanos.description: The elapsed time spent writing the blob, in nanoseconds.

write_throttled.description: The length of time spent waiting for the `max_snapshot_bytes_per_sec` (or `indices.recovery.max_bytes_per_sec` if the recovery settings for managed services are set) throttle while writing the blob.

write_throttled_nanos.description: The length of time spent waiting for the `max_snapshot_bytes_per_sec` (or `indices.recovery.max_bytes_per_sec` if the recovery settings for managed services are set) throttle while writing the blob, in nanoseconds.

writer_node.description: The node which wrote the blob and coordinated the read operations.

overwritten.description:
Indicates whether the blob was overwritten while the read operations were ongoing.
  /**

read_end.description: The position, in bytes, at which read operations completed.

read_start.description: The position, in bytes, at which read operations started.

reads.description: A description of every read operation performed on the blob.

size_bytes.description: The size of the blob in bytes.

before_write_complete.description: Indicates whether the read operation may have started before the write operation was complete.

elapsed.description:
The length of time spent reading the blob.
If the blob was not found, this detail is omitted.

elapsed_nanos.description:
The length of time spent reading the blob, in nanoseconds.
If the blob was not found, this detail is omitted.

first_byte_time.description:
The length of time waiting for the first byte of the read operation to be received.
If the blob was not found, this detail is omitted.

first_byte_time_nanos.description:
The length of time waiting for the first byte of the read operation to be received, in nanoseconds.
If the blob was not found, this detail is omitted.

found.description:
Indicates whether the blob was found by the read operation.
If the read was started before the write completed or the write was ended before completion, it might be false.

node.description: The node that performed the read operation.

throttled.description:
The length of time spent waiting due to the `max_restore_bytes_per_sec` or `indices.recovery.max_bytes_per_sec` throttles during the read of the blob.
If the blob was not found, this detail is omitted.

throttled_nanos.description:
The length of time spent waiting due to the `max_restore_bytes_per_sec` or `indices.recovery.max_bytes_per_sec` throttles during the read of the blob, in nanoseconds.
If the blob was not found, this detail is omitted.

read.description: A collection of statistics that summarise the results of the read operations in the test.

write.description: A collection of statistics that summarise the results of the write operations in the test.

count.description: The number of read operations performed in the test.

max_wait.description: The maximum time spent waiting for the first byte of any read request to be received.

max_wait_nanos.description: The maximum time spent waiting for the first byte of any read request to be received, in nanoseconds.

total_elapsed.description: The total elapsed time spent on reading blobs in the test.

total_elapsed_nanos.description: The total elapsed time spent on reading blobs in the test, in nanoseconds.

total_size.description: The total size of all the blobs or partial blobs read in the test.

total_size_bytes.description: The total size of all the blobs or partial blobs read in the test, in bytes.

total_throttled.description: The total time spent waiting due to the `max_restore_bytes_per_sec` or `indices.recovery.max_bytes_per_sec` throttles.

total_throttled_nanos.description: The total time spent waiting due to the `max_restore_bytes_per_sec` or `indices.recovery.max_bytes_per_sec` throttles, in nanoseconds.

total_wait.description: The total time spent waiting for the first byte of each read request to be received.

total_wait_nanos.description: The total time spent waiting for the first byte of each read request to be received, in nanoseconds.

count.description: The number of write operations performed in the test.

total_elapsed.description: The total elapsed time spent on writing blobs in the test.

total_elapsed_nanos.description: The total elapsed time spent on writing blobs in the test, in nanoseconds.

total_size.description: The total size of all the blobs written in the test.

total_size_bytes.description: The total size of all the blobs written in the test, in bytes.

total_throttled.description: The total time spent waiting due to the `max_snapshot_bytes_per_sec` throttle.

total_throttled_nanos.description: The total time spent waiting due to the `max_snapshot_bytes_per_sec` throttle, in nanoseconds.
